items.headline: Trump heads to China for talks with Xi and Putin
items.summary: President Trump is traveling to China to meet Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, his second such trip this year. The visit comes amid fallout over Nvidia chips and voter backlash in the midterms.

items.headline: Two FAA routers eyed as cause of ground stop
items.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said officials are analyzing two recently installed routers at FAA facilities in Arkansas and Texas, and Trump broke his silence to demand more money from Congress. Flight disruptions were expected to continue into Monday.

items.headline: Whistleblower says Iran attack warnings were ignored
items.summary: A U.S. Army major alleges that leaders dismissed warnings about inadequate protection at Port Shuaiba before a deadly Iranian drone attack. Democrats are calling for an investigation of military leaders.

items.headline: GOP chair faces rebellion after midterm losses
items.summary: Trump's handpicked Republican Party chair faces a revolt following the party's midterm defeats. The challenge is a rare test of Trump's grip on the GOP ahead of the 2028 nominating contest.

items.headline: NTSB: tanker's steering failed before cruise ship crash
items.summary: Federal investigators said the Atlantic Asphalt tanker's steering failed before it struck the American Heritage cruise ship in New Orleans on Friday. The Port of New Orleans is seeking at least $1 million in damages from the tanker's owners.

items.headline: Zelenskyy says Starshield limits hurt drone defense
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said restrictions on the Starshield satellite communications system are hindering Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian drones. He warned the limits threaten the defense of energy infrastructure ahead of winter.

items.headline: Congo's Ebola outbreak tops 11,000 cases
items.summary: Government data show more than 11,000 Ebola cases in Congo, with nearly half of those infected dead, six months into the response. It is the deadliest of the country's 17 outbreaks.

items.headline: Trump to appeal halt to Washington golf course plan
items.summary: A federal judge temporarily blocked the redevelopment of a historic public golf course in Washington, citing Trump's own social media posts as evidence. Trump criticized the two-week halt and said his administration will appeal.

items.headline: Megaspeed opens probe amid Nvidia chip scrutiny
items.summary: Megaspeed said it has launched an outside-led internal investigation amid scrutiny over alleged transfers of Nvidia chips to Chinese companies. The company said Alice Huang left in 2025.

items.headline: Warming threatens Arctic birds' long migrations
items.summary: Migratory birds that fly about 17,000 miles a year time their journeys to the seasons. A warming climate is increasingly pushing that timing out of sync.

digest.overview:
President Trump is heading to China to meet Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, his second such trip this year, amid fallout over Nvidia chips. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said investigators are examining two newly installed routers at FAA sites in Arkansas and Texas after Friday's nationwide ground stop, as Trump pressed Congress for more money and flight disruptions lingered into Monday. A Copa Airlines jet carrying 172 people and a UPS cargo plane collided on the ground in Miami, causing only minor injuries. The NTSB said a tanker's steering failed before it hit a cruise ship in New Orleans. Trump's handpicked Republican chair faces a rebellion after the midterm defeats, and Trump vowed to appeal a judge's halt to his Washington golf course project. An Army whistleblower says warnings were dismissed before a deadly Iranian drone attack on Port Shuaiba, prompting Democratic calls for a probe.

Abroad, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said restrictions on Ukraine's Starshield satellite system are hampering the interception of Russian drones ahead of winter. Congo's Ebola outbreak has passed 11,000 cases, with nearly half of those infected dead. Southeast Asian leaders opened their annual summit focused on South China Sea disputes and Myanmar's civil war. Megaspeed launched an internal probe amid scrutiny over alleged Nvidia chip transfers to Chinese companies. Pope Leo crossed Peru in the final days of his trip home, and scientists warn warming is pushing Arctic birds' 17,000-mile migrations out of sync.

home.overview:
Joe Burrow threw for 409 yards and four touchdowns as Cincinnati beat Pittsburgh 38–18 on Sunday night to grab the AFC North lead. San Francisco outlasted Dallas 46–40 in a never-before-seen final score, with Brock Purdy passing for a career-high 389 yards despite five touchdown throws from Dak Prescott. Detroit rolled past New England 35–10 in Munich, where Drake Maye left with an ankle injury, and Minnesota's 30–10 win at Green Bay created a three-way tie atop the NFC North. The winless Chargers visit Baltimore tonight. In the NBA, San Antonio won its 12th straight, Luka Doncic scored 43 in the Lakers' win at Phoenix, and Jalen Brunson's overtime 3 lifted the Knicks past Toronto. Baseball's qualifying-offer deadline arrives Tuesday afternoon.

England ended Spain's 44-match competitive unbeaten run with a 3–2 win in Madrid to top their Nations League group, and France edged Türkiye 2–1 to reach the quarterfinals as Belgium routed Italy 4–1. Germany host the Netherlands tonight, while the USA defend a 6–0 lead over Haiti in Mauricio Pochettino's farewell on Tuesday and South Korea face Qatar in Doha. The Premier League and K League return this weekend. In the KBO, free agency opens Tuesday, with Samsung's Korean Series MVP Koo Ja-wook reportedly eyeing the majors.

LG re-signed Austin Dean for $2 million, a record for a foreign position player in the KBO, after a 41-homer, 127-RBI season, and SSG signed former Reds right-hander Lyon Richardson for $1 million.
